summary: An 80-ft Aermotor LS-40 fire tower in Franklin State Forest, Marion County, built after 1940; state policy bars the public from climbing it.

access.note: The state says fire towers on state forests are not open to the public; visitors may photograph them but may not climb

visit.trail_note: Forest reached via State Highway 156; the tower may be photographed but not climbed

corrections.why: The NHLR detail page gives the build date as 'After 1940'; 1940 is the year the state took over management of the forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR calls it the Franklin State Forest tower; TNLandForms.us, an independent site, lists a Cave Spring tower at 1,864 ft in Marion County. Elevations match within a foot; neither source links the two names, so the match is recorded as likely.

notes_for_editor: Brief record said built 1940; NHLR says After 1940, so the correction stands. height_m 24.4 is the register's 80 ft converted. Access is closed per the state's fire tower policy, not a tower-specific closure order. Tower identity with TNLandForms.us Cave Spring is inferred from matching elevation and county; not confirmed by any source, and the story says 'likely', not 'very likely'. TNLandForms.us is an independent site, not a state list. Two WebSearch queries found nothing on the tower's build year or staffing. No photos added.
